name: AL F.
text: Tee and Mo were so so nice when we came by! They have a really good variety, and take pictures of their customers. So there are Polaroids all over the walls and post its they let their customers write stuff on, and put up. If you’re in Ekkamai, I HIGHLY recommend!
reply: Thank you so much 😊 looking forward to see you again Feanklyn

name: Harley H.
text: This is the best weed I’ve been able to find in Bangkok. It’s a bit far from my place but I keep ordering from here cause it’s just plain better… All the strains we’ve ordered have been consistently smooth, perfectly cured, and the terps are just incredibly preserved.

name: Danica
text: What an excellent shop. I found this shop on google maps and rode over on my motorcycle. The weed was better than expected… Afterwards I went upstairs, chilled on a bean bag and blazed. Very impressed with the weed and the staff was very polite and pleasant.

name: Bryan C.
text: The Best in BANGKOK so far, The best prices ever! I been in Bangkok over 6 times and I always buy with them, the most respectful stuff and really Kind! I’m glad I found this place from my first time in Thailand 💎

name: Daddy C.
text: Prolly the best shop in town, would recommend — the prices are immaculate, service is top tier, the counter guy is super friendly. 10/10
